data.one_liner: A Dart scheduler that runs tasks at cron‑style times or intervals.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Cron class to schedule callbacks based on cron expressions or fixed intervals. Parses standard 5‑part or 6‑part cron strings and supports mocking time via the clock package.
use_when: You need periodic background work in a pure Dart or Flutter app
You want cron‑like scheduling without native platform code
You need to test time‑dependent code with mockable clocks
avoid_when: You need distributed job coordination across multiple devices
strengths: Supports intervals, seconds, and mockable time
Null‑safe and pure Dart, works on all platforms
weaknesses: No built‑in persistence; tasks disappear on app restart
No advanced features like job queues or retries
